notes.title: Our new game - "Otaku's Rage: Waifu's strikes back"
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34977126/247f83bcf36c4fd7ef479ac130e75035b2ce5109.png[/img]

Hello everyone!

Today I want to announce that our new game [b]Otaku's Rage: Waifu's strikes back[/b] is finally coming to the release.
We will release it in January! You can add it to your wishlist right now to not miss it :)

***

"You scroll through the list of new games and you don't feel like playing any one. TV shows have long since been boring, and so are the bloggers. In this world, there isn't anything good left, and your sister has driven you out into the street. Is it really true that life is only humiliation and suffering?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34638268/57ee4c8ea9918b5590fa85b28e7ddfa6a0d6331b.gif[/img]

But what if it is all just a bad dream, and in actuality you are a super cool epic hero in the World of Waifu, and the evil witch has walled you within this hell"

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1316560/Otakus_Rage_Waifu_Strikes_Back/

notes.title: The Bunker 69 is available on Steam!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34977126/cdb032415d6ba915ec7b0dafb649708908a148f8.png[/img]

After 20 years of living in a terrible post-apocalyptic world, you find yourself in a miraculously undiscovered bunker, which... is filled with food and beautiful girls. It seems that your life is about to change, but... you can not even imagine how much.

This is a harem comic adventure, where you can become acquainted with four girls - the residents of the bunker. They are surprisingly very pleased with their new guest. Perhaps this is because they’ve never seen anyone from the "surface"? Or is there something else?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1150890/The_Bunker_69/

notes.title: This Fall will be HOT!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I just wanted to say that in the near future a lot of interesting things will be waiting for you (at least those who do not follow our activities on patreon).

Our main project [b]My Little Angel[/b] will soon become public (yes, it will never be on Steam, so it will be completely free on our site/patreon page).

This month there will be a release of our new little game [b]The Bunker 69[/b]. Right now you can add it to your wishlist on this page ^ _ ^

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1150890/The_Bunker_69/

Also in the near future there will be a Steam demo version of our new main project [b]The Lewd Knight[/b]. You can also add it to your wishlist here ^_^

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1129520/The_Lewd_Knight/
